name: smwmusic-america-a-horse-with-no-name
title: America - A Horse with No Name
description:
A Horse with No Name is an American folk rock song by American artist America. It is a light and relaxed tune with acoustic guitars, horns, bass, cymbals, and yoshi drums. Perfect for desert levels.


In the desert you can't remember your name, for there ain't no one for to give you no pain.
